frozen_design.cohort_and_split: Exactly the base pilot's20 identities and10/10 metadata-only age-pair/hash split; independently recompute from authenticated metadata.
frozen_design.source_support: Discovery-only intersection of geometry and public no-band-pass activity rule. Prior pilot observed400; recompute rather than copy. Never shrink it using evaluation activity.
frozen_design.preprocessing: Inherited identity-world nearest labels, originalfloat64 scaling,168frames, selected15confounds, no-band-pass nuisance removal; no censoring, epsilon correlations or support repair.
frozen_design.group_FC: Equal-person arithmetic mean of ten discovery Pearson FCs; diagonal1; upper triangle mirrored.
frozen_design.operator: Retain ceil(0.1*P) largest signed FC values per row including diagonal eligibility; exact ties smaller original parcel ID. Normalized-angle kernel; alpha0.5; real symmetric diffusion operator.
frozen_design.principal_axis: Largest algebraic nontrivial eigenvector; no network-label selection, alignment or multicomponent rotation.
frozen_design.discovery_stability: All ten leave-one-discovery-person group FC/operator fits on unchanged discovery support. Report gap and squared principal-axis overlap when both axes identifiable; no outcome-selected alternative.
frozen_design.evaluation: Each of the ten fixed evaluation slots uses frozen support. Source-inactive row remains explicitnull; valid people are scored independently. Frozen fit artifact read-only and hash-checked before/after.
frozen_design.primary: Remove heldout stationary component from frozen unit discoveryaxis; normalize if resolved; report R=v^T K v,lambda1,R/lambda1,stationary_overlap_squared,projectionnorm,heldoutgap,spectralmean=(traceK-1)/(P-1),R-minus-spectralmean. Ratio alone is not selective transfer.
frozen_design.secondary: Sign/scale-invariant C=(meanDefault(g)-meanVis(g))*(meanDefault(g)-meanSomMot(g))/var_parcels(g). For unresolved leading block, full-span min/max; never choose favorable basis. C is not global DMN apex.
frozen_design.leading_block: Maximal contiguous leading nontrivial eigenvalue block whose successive gaps are <=4e-8; include its full certified span. Boundary and rank reported.
frozen_design.spectral_nulls: Inherited4e-8 numerical gap/energy envelope; non-simple stationary mode, unresolved discoveryaxis,projectionnorm<=1e-12 orheldoutlambda1<=4e-8 gives explicitprimarynull. No fabricated/blanketnull accepted.
frozen_design.network_nulls: Source-inactive, non-simple stationary mode or constant diffusion-coordinate span; all actual leading eigenvalues and block rank retained. Range rank threshold per public protocol1e-10 after column equilibration.
frozen_design.inference: Descriptive fixed-cohort/shared-movie method validation only; no pvalues, population CIs, required positive effect or new difficulty claim.

independence.production: Pinned original-byte decoder and nearest-grid extraction; explicit QR cleaning; NumPy Pearson; publicoperator; stationary-orthogonal QR plus SciPy symmetric eigensolve; public prototype scalar/range routines.
independence.checker: Separately decode authenticated NIfTI bytes with explicit raw-storage scaling; explicit homogeneous-coordinate nearest sampling; bincount parcel sums; SVD nuisance projection using only the public QR-kept rank and certifying equality of the kept projector, never an alternative rank cutoff; normalized-vector dot-product correlations; separate row sorting/kernel/degree arithmetic; full symmetric NumPy eigensolve; independently composed Rayleigh and generalized quadratic-form range.
independence.shared: Immutable source/capsule authentication, fixed metadata/LUT parsing, high-level recipe orchestration including aggregation and null dispatch, NumPy/SciPy/NiBabel libraries and public contract. A separate accounting audit rechecks fixed slots, source/numerical null reasons and participant summary arithmetic. Not a fully independent complete verifier, independent raw dataset or anatomical registration. Checker never calls production cleaning/operator/endpoint functions or legacycore numerical routines.
independence.numerical_equivalence: Certificate-valid eigenvectors and full repeated-block spans accepted; no private sign/basis fingerprint. Check source-canonical sparsity membership separately; disagreement stops qualification rather than tuning after results.

engineering_envelopes_not_final_scoring_.scope: Source/clean/FC/scalar envelopes inherited from prior public contract; operator envelope is a prospective engineering bound for independently composed kernel arithmetic, not a scientific similarity threshold or final grader. Report maximum differences and stop on any failure, no widening after observation.

deliverable_boundary: Fullsource/matrix/hash/certificate receipts are private authoring QA. Future agent-facing interface is frozen discoveryartifact plus keyed person-level scientific report, not all authoring housekeeping.
qualification_not_benchmark_pass: No Sol, Harbor, regrade, public PR change or reward computation; successful numerical qualification is not evidence of empirical difficulty or anatomical validity.
